passages.text: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion; sound the alarm on My holy mountain! Let all who dwell in the land tremble, for the Day of the LORD is coming; indeed, it is near— a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness. Like the dawn overspreading the mountains a great and strong army appears, such as never was of old, nor will ever be in ages to come.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Joel speaks to the people of Israel.
He warns them about the coming Day of the LORD.
Blow the ram’s horn in Zion.
Sound the alarm on God’s holy mountain.
All who live in the land must tremble.
The Day of the LORD is coming.
This day is very near.
It will be a day of darkness.
It will be a day of gloom.
It will be a day of clouds.
It will be a day of thick darkness.
The darkness will spread over the mountains like the dawn.
A great and powerful army will appear.
No army like this has ever come before.
No army like this will ever come again in all generations.
passages.original: תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֜ר בְּצִיּ֗וֹן וְהָרִ֙יעוּ֙ בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֔י יִרְגְּז֕וּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־ בָ֥א יוֹם־ יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֥י קָרֽוֹב׃ י֧וֹם חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וַאֲפֵלָ֗ה י֤וֹם עָנָן֙ וַעֲרָפֶ֔ל כְּשַׁ֖חַר פָּרֻ֣שׂ עַל־ הֶֽהָרִ֑ים עַ֚ם רַ֣ב וְעָצ֔וּם כָּמֹ֗הוּ לֹ֤א נִֽהְיָה֙ מִן־ הָ֣עוֹלָ֔ם וְאַֽחֲרָיו֙ לֹ֣א יוֹסֵ֔ף עַד־ שְׁנֵ֖י דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Before them a fire devours, and behind them a flame scorches. The land before them is like the Garden of Eden, but behind them, it is like a desert wasteland— surely nothing will escape them.
passages.sermon:
A great and strong army comes.
Fire goes before this army.
The fire devours everything in its path.
Flames burn behind this army.
The land in front of the army looks like the Garden of Eden.
The land behind the army becomes a desert wasteland.
Nothing escapes from this army.
passages.original: לְפָנָיו֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֵ֔שׁ וְאַחֲרָ֖יו תְּלַהֵ֣ט לֶֽהָבָ֑ה כְּגַן־ עֵ֨דֶן הָאָ֜רֶץ לְפָנָ֗יו וְאַֽחֲרָיו֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְגַם־ פְּלֵיטָ֖ה לֹא־ הָ֥יְתָה לּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Their appearance is like that of horses, and they gallop like swift steeds.
passages.sermon:
A great and strong army appears.
This army looks like horses.
They run fast like warhorses.
They move quickly like charging steeds.
passages.original: כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה סוּסִ֖ים מַרְאֵ֑הוּ וּכְפָרָשִׁ֖ים כֵּ֥ן יְרוּצֽוּן׃

passages.text: With a sound like that of chariots they bound over the mountaintops, like the crackling of fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army deployed for battle.
passages.sermon:
A great army comes.
This army moves with power.
They make a sound like chariots.
They leap over the tops of mountains.
Their noise is like fire burning dry straw.
They are strong and ready for battle.
passages.original: כְּק֣וֹל מַרְכָּב֗וֹת עַל־ רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶֽהָרִים֙ יְרַקֵּד֔וּן כְּקוֹל֙ לַ֣הַב אֵ֔שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה קָ֑שׁ כְּעַ֣ם עָצ֔וּם עֱר֖וּךְ מִלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: Nations writhe in horror before them; every face turns pale.
passages.sermon:
A great and terrible army advances.
Nations see this army.
Nations tremble with fear.
People feel horror.
Every face grows pale.
passages.original: מִפָּנָ֖יו יָחִ֣ילוּ עַמִּ֑ים כָּל־ פָּנִ֖ים קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר׃

passages.text: They charge like mighty men; they scale the walls like men of war. Each one marches in formation, not swerving from the course.
passages.sermon:
A mighty army comes.
They charge forward like strong men.
They climb walls like skilled soldiers.
Each soldier marches in his own path.
No one leaves his course.
They do not break formation.
passages.original: כְּגִבּוֹרִ֣ים יְרֻצ֔וּן כְּאַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה יַעֲל֣וּ חוֹמָ֑ה וְאִ֤ישׁ בִּדְרָכָיו֙ יֵֽלֵכ֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יְעַבְּט֖וּן אֹרְחוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: They do not jostle one another; each proceeds in his path. They burst through the defenses, never breaking ranks.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes the LORD’s army.
The army moves with perfect order.
No one pushes his companion.
Each man walks straight in his own path.
They face weapons and obstacles.
They break through the defenses.
They do not break ranks.
passages.original: וְאִ֤ישׁ אָחִיו֙ לֹ֣א יִדְחָק֔וּן גֶּ֥בֶר בִּמְסִלָּת֖וֹ יֵֽלֵכ֑וּן וּבְעַ֥ד הַשֶּׁ֛לַח יִפֹּ֖לוּ לֹ֥א יִבְצָֽעוּ׃

passages.text: They storm the city; they run along the wall; they climb into houses, entering through windows like thieves.
passages.sermon:
A mighty army attacks the city.
They rush along the city wall.
They climb into houses.
They enter through the windows.
They come in like thieves.
passages.original: בָּעִ֣יר יָשֹׁ֗קּוּ בַּֽחוֹמָה֙ יְרֻצ֔וּן בַּבָּתִּ֖ים יַעֲל֑וּ בְּעַ֧ד הַחַלּוֹנִ֛ים יָבֹ֖אוּ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃

passages.text: Before them the earth quakes; the heavens tremble. The sun and moon grow dark, and the stars lose their brightness.
passages.sermon:
God leads a mighty army.
The earth shakes before this army.
The heavens tremble before them.
The sun grows dark.
The moon grows dark.
The stars lose their brightness.
passages.original: לְפָנָיו֙ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֔רֶץ רָעֲשׁ֖וּ שָׁמָ֑יִם שֶׁ֤מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֙חַ֙ קָדָ֔רוּ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נָגְהָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD raises His voice in the presence of His army. Indeed, His camp is very large, for mighty are those who obey His command. For the Day of the LORD is great and very dreadful. Who can endure it?
passages.sermon:
The LORD stands before His army.
The LORD raises His voice.
His army is very large.
Those who obey His command are mighty.
The Day of the LORD is great.
The Day of the LORD is very dreadful.
No one can endure it.
passages.original: וַֽיהוָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן קוֹלוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י חֵיל֔וֹ כִּ֣י רַ֤ב מְאֹד֙ מַחֲנֵ֔הוּ כִּ֥י עָצ֖וּם עֹשֵׂ֣ה דְבָר֑וֹ כִּֽי־ גָד֧וֹל יוֹם־ יְהוָ֛ה וְנוֹרָ֥א מְאֹ֖ד וּמִ֥י יְכִילֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: “Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks now.
He says, "Return to Me."
Return with all your heart.
Return with fasting.
Return with weeping.
Return with mourning.
passages.original: וְגַם־ עַתָּה֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה שֻׁ֥בוּ עָדַ֖י בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וּבְצ֥וֹם וּבְבְכִ֖י וּבְמִסְפֵּֽד׃

passages.text: So rend your hearts and not your garments, and return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion. And He relents from sending disaster.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God is gracious.
God is compassionate.
God is slow to anger.
God abounds in loving devotion.
God relents from sending disaster.
Return to God.
Tear your hearts, not your clothes.
passages.original: וְקִרְע֤וּ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַל־ בִּגְדֵיכֶ֔ם וְשׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ חַנּ֤וּן וְרַחוּם֙ ה֔וּא אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֙יִם֙ וְרַב־ חֶ֔סֶד וְנִחָ֖ם עַל־ הָרָעָֽה׃

passages.text: Who knows? He may turn and relent and leave a blessing behind Him— grain and drink offerings for the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God is gracious and compassionate.
God is slow to anger.
God is full of loving devotion.
God sometimes relents from sending disaster.
No one can be certain what God will do.
Perhaps God will turn back from judgment.
Perhaps God will show mercy.
Perhaps God will leave a blessing behind Him.
Perhaps you will have grain and drink.
Then you can offer grain and drink offerings to the LORD your God.
passages.original: מִ֥י יוֹדֵ֖עַ יָשׁ֣וּב וְנִחָ֑ם וְהִשְׁאִ֤יר אַֽחֲרָיו֙ בְּרָכָ֔ה מִנְחָ֣ה וָנֶ֔סֶךְ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion, consecrate a fast, proclaim a sacred assembly.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Joel speaks to the people of Israel.
He commands them to act in Zion.
Blow the ram’s horn in Zion.
Set apart a time for fasting.
Announce a sacred gathering.
passages.original: תִּקְע֥וּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּצִיּ֑וֹן קַדְּשׁוּ־ צ֖וֹם קִרְא֥וּ עֲצָרָֽה׃

passages.text: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the aged, gather the children, even those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room, and the bride her chamber.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to His people through the prophet Joel.
He called everyone to come together.
Gather the people.
Make the congregation holy.
Bring together the elders.
Gather the children.
Bring even the babies who are still nursing.
Let the bridegroom come out of his room.
Let the bride leave her chamber.
passages.original: אִסְפוּ־ עָ֞ם קַדְּשׁ֤וּ קָהָל֙ קִבְצ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֔ים אִסְפוּ֙ עֽוֹלָלִ֔ים וְיֹנְקֵ֖י שָׁדָ֑יִם יֵצֵ֤א חָתָן֙ מֵֽחֶדְר֔וֹ וְכַלָּ֖ה מֵחֻפָּתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Let the priests who minister before the LORD weep between the portico and the altar, saying, “Spare Your people, O LORD, and do not make Your heritage a reproach, an object of scorn among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’ ”
passages.sermon:
The priests serve the LORD.
The priests stand between the portico and the altar.
The priests weep there.
The priests say, “Spare Your people, O LORD.”
The priests say, “Do not let Your heritage become a reproach.”
The priests say, “Do not let the nations rule over Your people.”
The priests say, “Why should the peoples say, ‘Where is their God?’”
passages.original: בֵּ֤ין הָאוּלָם֙ וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ יִבְכּוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְֽיֹאמְר֞וּ ח֧וּסָה יְהוָ֣ה עַל־ עַמֶּ֗ךָ וְאַל־ תִּתֵּ֨ן נַחֲלָתְךָ֤ לְחֶרְפָּה֙ לִמְשָׁל־ בָּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם לָ֚מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ בָֽעַמִּ֔ים אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then the LORD became jealous for His land, and He spared His people.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD cares deeply for His land.
The LORD became jealous for His land.
The LORD showed compassion to His people.
The LORD spared His people.
passages.original: וַיְקַנֵּ֥א יְהוָ֖ה לְאַרְצ֑וֹ וַיַּחְמֹ֖ל עַל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And the LORD answered His people: “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and by them you will be satisfied. I will never again make you a reproach among the nations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to His people.
He said, “I will send you grain.
I will send you new wine.
I will send you oil.
You will have enough.
You will be satisfied.
I will not let the nations shame you again.
You will not be a reproach among them.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַן יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעַמּ֗וֹ הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַדָּגָן֙ וְהַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֔ר וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֖ם אֹת֑וֹ וְלֹא־ אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְכֶ֥ם ע֛וֹד חֶרְפָּ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: The northern army I will drive away from you, banishing it to a barren and desolate land, its front ranks into the Eastern Sea, and its rear guard into the Western Sea. And its stench will rise; its foul odor will ascend. For He has done great things.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
The LORD promises to act.
The LORD will drive away the northern army from you.
He will send the northern army far from you.
He will banish the army to a barren and empty land.
He will send the front of the army into the Eastern Sea.
He will send the rear of the army into the Western Sea.
The stench of the army will rise.
The foul odor will go up.
The LORD has done great things.
passages.original: וְֽאֶת־ הַצְּפוֹנִ֞י אַרְחִ֣יק מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִדַּחְתִּיו֮ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וּשְׁמָמָה֒ אֶת־ פָּנָ֗יו אֶל־ הַיָּם֙ הַקַּדְמֹנִ֔י וְסֹפ֖וֹ אֶל־ הַיָּ֣ם הָאַֽחֲר֑וֹן וְעָלָ֣ה בָאְשׁ֗וֹ וְתַ֙עַל֙ צַחֲנָת֔וֹ כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֖יל לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

passages.text: Do not be afraid, O land; rejoice and be glad, for the LORD has done great things.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and good.
The LORD has done great things.
Land, do not be afraid.
Land, rejoice.
Land, be glad.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְאִ֖י אֲדָמָ֑ה גִּ֣ילִי וּשְׂמָ֔חִי כִּֽי־ הִגְדִּ֥יל יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

passages.text: Do not be afraid, O beasts of the field, for the open pastures have turned green, the trees bear their fruit, and the fig tree and vine yield their best.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the animals of the field.
He says, “Do not be afraid.”
The pastures in the wilderness have become green.
The trees now bear their fruit.
The fig tree gives its fruit.
The vine gives its strength.
God has restored the land.
The animals will have food again.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְאוּ֙ בַּהֲמ֣וֹת שָׂדַ֔י כִּ֥י דָשְׁא֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר כִּֽי־ עֵץ֙ נָשָׂ֣א פִרְי֔וֹ תְּאֵנָ֥ה וָגֶ֖פֶן נָתְנ֥וּ חֵילָֽם׃

passages.text: Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication. He sends you showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.
passages.sermon:
The children of Zion are God's people.
God is the LORD.
God is your God.
Be glad, children of Zion.
Rejoice in the LORD your God.
God has given you the autumn rains.
God gave these rains to show you are right with Him.
God sends you showers.
God sends both autumn and spring rains.
God gives these rains as He did before.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן גִּ֤ילוּ וְשִׂמְחוּ֙ בַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ נָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־ הַמּוֹרֶ֖ה לִצְדָקָ֑ה וַיּ֣וֹרֶד לָכֶ֗ם גֶּ֛שֶׁם מוֹרֶ֥ה וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ בָּרִאשֽׁוֹן׃

passages.text: The threshing floors will be full of grain, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
passages.sermon:
God promised to bless His people.
He will fill the threshing floors with grain.
The vats will overflow with new wine.
The vats will also overflow with oil.
passages.original: וּמָלְא֥וּ הַגֳּרָנ֖וֹת בָּ֑ר וְהֵשִׁ֥יקוּ הַיְקָבִ֖ים תִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָֽר׃

passages.text: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts— the swarming locust, the young locust, the destroying locust, and the devouring locust — My great army that I sent against you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God promises to repay them.
He will repay them for the years they lost.
Locusts destroyed their crops in those years.
There were different kinds of locusts.
There were swarming locusts.
There were young locusts.
There were destroying locusts.
There were devouring locusts.
God calls these locusts His great army.
God sent this army of locusts against His people.
God will restore what the locusts took away.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֙ אָכַ֣ל הָֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה הַיֶּ֖לֶק וְהֶחָסִ֣יל וְהַגָּזָ֑ם חֵילִי֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁלַּ֖חְתִּי בָּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You will have plenty to eat, until you are satisfied. You will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you. My people will never again be put to shame.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God has done wonders for you.
You will eat.
You will have enough food.
You will be satisfied.
You will praise the name of the LORD your God.
God’s people will never be put to shame again.
passages.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אָכוֹל֙ וְשָׂב֔וֹעַ וְהִלַּלְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־ שֵׁ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה עִמָּכֶ֖ם לְהַפְלִ֑יא וְלֹא־ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Then you will know that I am present in Israel and that I am the LORD your God, and there is no other. My people will never again be put to shame.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God says, “I am present among you.”
I am the LORD your God.
There is no other God besides Me.
My people will never again be put to shame.
passages.original: וִידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י בְקֶ֤רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אָ֔נִי וַאֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין ע֑וֹד וְלֹא־ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס

passages.text: And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God will act after these things happen.
God will pour out His Spirit on all people.
God will give His Spirit to everyone, not just a few.
Your sons will prophesy.
Your daughters will prophesy.
Your old men will dream dreams.
Your young men will see visions.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ אֶת־ רוּחִי֙ עַל־ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֔ר וְנִבְּא֖וּ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם זִקְנֵיכֶם֙ חֲלֹמ֣וֹת יַחֲלֹמ֔וּן בַּח֣וּרֵיכֶ֔ם חֶזְיֹנ֖וֹת יִרְאֽוּ׃

passages.text: Even on My menservants and maidservants, I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to the people of Israel.
God is the LORD.
God alone is their God.
God promises to act in the future.
God says, “In those days, I will pour out My Spirit.”
God will pour out His Spirit on all people.
God includes menservants and maidservants.
God will pour out His Spirit on menservants.
God will pour out His Spirit on maidservants.
God will do this in those days.
passages.original: וְגַ֥ם עַל־ הָֽעֲבָדִ֖ים וְעַל־ הַשְּׁפָח֑וֹת בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔מָּה אֶשְׁפּ֖וֹךְ אֶת־ רוּחִֽי׃

passages.text: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke.
passages.sermon:
God will act.
God will show wonders.
These wonders will appear in the heavens.
These wonders will also appear on the earth.
There will be blood.
There will be fire.
There will be columns of smoke.
passages.original: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ מֽוֹפְתִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ דָּ֣ם וָאֵ֔שׁ וְתִֽימֲר֖וֹת עָשָֽׁן׃

passages.text: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God will act with great power.
God will show signs in the sky.
The sun will become dark.
The moon will become like blood.
These things will happen before the Day of the LORD.
The Day of the LORD will be great.
The Day of the LORD will be awesome.
passages.original: הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ יֵהָפֵ֣ךְ לְחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהַיָּרֵ֖חַ לְדָ֑ם לִפְנֵ֗י בּ֚וֹא י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָֽא׃

passages.text: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD saves people.
Anyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved.
The LORD will give deliverance on Mount Zion.
The LORD will give deliverance in Jerusalem.
The LORD promised this deliverance.
The LORD will save the remnant.
The LORD calls this remnant.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כֹּ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָ֛א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה יִמָּלֵ֑ט כִּ֠י בְּהַר־ צִיּ֨וֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה פְלֵיטָ֗ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וּבַ֨שְּׂרִידִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה קֹרֵֽא׃
